_about: My validity review (manual) of every scenario Qwen's writer got accepted in runs/gen_02, in the format of autogen_02/eval/phase4_review.json: a verdict per scenario (valid, weak but valid, flawed, invalid) and per near miss, under the PI's criteria of 2026-09-28 (a near miss the agent cannot check, or that a natural reading of the request includes, is flawed; ambiguous ones case by case, with the PI's rulings as precedents) and the method's rules (each near miss fails exactly one condition; the target meets all; background records fail at least two; anchors survive; readable through the replica). Read before any solver run of these scenarios. My rulings, for the PI to overrule.

The clock rule gives the tests the written-at moment (2026-09-30), after every date in the data. All three brief facts covered validly.
